name: bullswarm
description: Bullswarm as a Claude Mod: live subscription meters for every installed coding-agent CLI above the prompt, quota-aware routing of Claude's own subagents to whichever pool has surplus, a verdict note on every bullswarm command the model runs, a /bullswarm command, and $.bullswarm for other plugins.

poolAliases.title: Pool display names
poolAliases.description: Display names for pools in the strip and pane, as from=to pairs separated by commas (claude-code:acme=claude-code:w). Without one, an account pool shows as prefix:<first letter of its slug>.

strip.title: Strip above the prompt
strip.description: What the band above the prompt shows: runs (the ongoing workflow runs; the pool meters live in the runs pane), full (pool meters too), off (nothing; /bullswarm pane still opens the pane).
